section: S1 — Switch between display options
title: Display switcher offers List, Tech View and Board View and marks the active one
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes. Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List. One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location. [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher" (used by this case only) with two Approved work orders: [WO-1] led by [Tech-A] and [WO-2] with no lead. Work Orders starts in List (the expected results say List is highlighted at the start). Names and numbers are examples; what must hold: there are work orders to show in every display and the page starts in List. Setup Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard). Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A]. [WO-2] (e.g. S1-352): no lead (Lead Technician left empty). Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > click Search and type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher": exactly [WO-1] (lead [Tech-A]) and [WO-2] (no lead) show. If a lead is wrong, fix it on the work order page. Then clear the search; if the page is not in List, click List (tooltip "List") in the display switcher.
steps: Open Work Orders from the top navigation. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar. Look at the display switcher at the right of the toolbar and hover each of its buttons. Write down the label or tooltip of each button and which one is highlighted. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View"). Look at which switcher button is highlighted now. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View"). Look at which switcher button is highlighted now. In the display switcher, click List (tooltip "List").
expected: Expected results The switcher offers exactly three display options: List, Tech View and Board View. Only the option you are viewing is highlighted: List at the start, Tech View after step 5, Board View after step 7, List again after step 9. Write down the words you see on each button or tooltip. The design's tooltips read "Table", "By Lead Tech" and "Board". A different label alone is not a fail (the wording is an open product question), but a missing option or no highlight is. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R1, S1-R9, read 8 Oct 2026. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), toolbar view switch (aria-label "View"); on-screen labels only. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S1-R1: “The Work Orders toolbar offers List, Tech View, and Board View display options.” S1-R9: “The switcher visually indicates the active display option.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. AUTOMATION: READY

section: S1 — Switch between display options
title: A user who never chose a display sees List

[User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. [User-B]: a brand-new user who has never opened Work Orders, with a role that has Work Orders view (e.g. Service Advisor) and this location picked in Location, and an email you can open. Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List. One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location. Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Default List" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A]. Names are examples; what must hold: [User-B] has never opened Work Orders (so has never chosen a display). Setup Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard). Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Default List" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Default List": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A]. Create a brand-new user who has never opened Work Orders: Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member with an email you can open (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Never Chose"), a role with Work Orders view (e.g. Service Advisor), at least one Department (required), with this location picked in Location > Save & Close. Accept the invitation and set a password, but do not open Work Orders as this user. Record this user as [User-B]. Check the setup worked: as [User-A], Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Default List" shows [WO-1]; Settings > Staff lists [User-B] at this location. If [User-B] has already opened Work Orders, create another new user and use that one.
steps: Sign out. Sign in as [User-B]. Open Work Orders from the top navigation. Look at the work orders area and the display switcher. Refresh the page. Look at the display again.
expected: Expected results The page opens in List: the ordinary work order table, not grouped by technician and not shown as columns of cards. In the display switcher the List option is the highlighted one. After the refresh the page is still in List. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R2, Key Decisions, read 8 Oct 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S1-R2: “List is the default display option for every user until they choose another.” Key Decisions: “Default display option remains List. Existing users see no change until they choose otherwise.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. AUTOMATION: READY

Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Fisquare" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRL-903") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A]. [WO-2] (e.g. S1-691): Lead Technician = [Tech-B]. [WO-3] (e.g. S1-352): no lead (Lead Technician left empty). Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST Fisquare": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-4]: any lead. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge" shows exactly 3 rows, [WO-1] (lead [Tech-A]), [WO-2] (lead [Tech-B]) and [WO-3] (no lead), all Approved, and not [WO-4]. If more work orders show (e.g. left from an earlier run), change the status of each extra one to Declined with the status control on the work order page, so the Approved filter in step 4 leaves it out. Then clear the search.
steps: Open Work Orders. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar. Click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge. Open the Status filter, tick Approved (the status the setup gave your test work orders) and close the filter. In List, write down every work order number shown ([WO-1], [WO-2], [WO-3]: 3 rows). In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View"). Write down the work order numbers shown and each group header count. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View"). Write down the work order numbers on the cards and each column header count. In the display switcher, click List (tooltip "List").
expected: Expected results The layout changes straight away on each click, without a page reload. After every switch the All tab is still selected, the search box still reads ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge and the Status filter still shows the status you ticked. The same work orders appear in all three displays. With the example data: List shows 3 rows, Tech View shows the same 3 (Unassigned 1 + Esther Howard 1 + Ralph Edwards 1 = 3) and Board View shows the same 3 cards. The ZZAUTOTEST Fisquare work order appears in none of them. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R3, Feature Overview, read 8 Oct 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S1-R3: “Switching display options immediately re-lays out the current results without changing the filter view, search text, or filters.” Feature Overview: “The existing filter views (the tabs on the left — All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed) and the filter bar (search, status, assigned to me, and so on) apply the same way in every display option.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. section: S1 — Switch between display options
title: The chosen display follows the user to new sign-ins, devices and locations
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · a second location · about 20 minutes. Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. [User-B]: a second user with Work Orders view who has never changed the display (e.g. a Service Advisor), at the first location. Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List. One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location. [Loc-2]: a second location your user ([User-A]) is enrolled at. A second browser (or another computer) is available. [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Follows User" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A]. [User-A] can be in any display before step 2. Names are examples; what must hold: [User-B] has never changed the display, so still sees List. Setup Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard). Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Follows User" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Follows User": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A]. Make sure your user is enrolled at a second location (Settings > Staff > open your staff record > add the second location, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Location 2"; if no second location exists, create one first: Settings > Locations > New Location > fill in and save). Record it as [Loc-2]. Have a second user with Work Orders view who has never changed the display (e.g. a Service Advisor). Add one in Settings > Staff if needed: New Staff Member with an email you can open (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Second Viewer"), a role with Work Orders view, at least one Department (required), this location in Location > Save & Close; accept the invitation and set a password. Record this user as [User-B]. Check the setup worked: your initials > Change Location lists [Loc-2]; Settings > Staff lists [User-B]; Work Orders > All > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Follows User" shows [WO-1]. If [User-B] has ever changed the display, create another new user.
steps: Open Work Orders. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View"). Sign out, then sign in again as the same user. Open Work Orders and note the display. In the second browser, sign in as the same user ([User-A]) and open Work Orders. Note the display. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location and pick [Loc-2] and open Work Orders. Note the display. Sign out and sign in as [User-B]. Open Work Orders and note the display.
expected: Expected results After signing in again, Work Orders opens in Board View. In the second browser, Work Orders opens in Board View. At the second location, Work Orders opens in Board View. The second user still sees List: the choice was saved for your user only. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R4, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions Confluence 853901313, DR-6 (display option persists across locations). Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S1-R4: “Save the selected display option per user. It follows the user after logout/login, on other devices, and in other locations.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. AUTOMATION: READY

steps: Open Work Orders. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar. In List, click Search and type [Unit-1]. Write down the work orders shown (with this setup: [WO-1] only). section: S4 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician
title: Invoiced and Paid work orders show why the lead can't be changed
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 25 minutes. Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher. One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location. [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Locked Lead Tooltip" (used by this case only), with a contact, and two work orders with Lead Technician [Tech-A] set before invoicing: [WO-1] Invoiced and [WO-2] Paid. Names and numbers are examples; what must hold: one Invoiced and one Paid work order, both with a lead. Setup Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard). Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Locked Lead Tooltip" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. How to reach each status (standard steps): Estimate = a new work order whose lines are not approved. Approved = approve its lines. In Progress = a technician clicks Start time clock on an approved line's Labor row. Review = set the work order to Ready for Review with its status control. Complete = enter a tech story on every line, complete each line, then complete the work order. Invoiced = Finance tab > Create Invoice (the work order needs a contact person). Paid = record a full payment on that invoice. Declined = decline the estimate. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Locked Lead Tooltip": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-1] (e.g. S1-511): Lead Technician = [Tech-A], then taken to Invoiced. [WO-2] (e.g. S1-366): Lead Technician = [Tech-A], then taken to Paid. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Locked Lead Tooltip" shows [WO-1] (Invoiced) and [WO-2] (Paid), both led by [Tech-A]. If not, fix the status or lead before starting; then clear the search.
steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View"). Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Locked Lead Tooltip" in Search. Look at the [WO-1] card and write down any sign that it can only be reordered within its technician (e.g. a lock icon) and any tooltip shown when you hover that sign. Hover the card, click More actions and hover the Reassign lead technician action. Read the tooltip shown next to the Reassign lead technician action. Repeat steps 3 to 5 for [WO-2]. Repeat steps 3 to 6 in Tech View on the rows.
expected: Expected results Reassign lead technician is shown disabled, and its tooltip reads exactly: The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid. (A straight or curly apostrophe is not a difference.) The Invoiced and Paid cards and rows carry a visible sign that they can only be reordered within their current technician and not moved to another one. The PRD does not fix its look; write down what you see. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N6, S4-N7, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD §9 User Feedback Summary row "Reassignment not allowed in current status". Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): lock icon next to the number with tooltip "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned" and a locked menu note; the PRD tooltip text is asserted here. Source-verified 8 October 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S4-N6: “The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Invoiced or Paid work order shows this tooltip: “The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.”” S4-N7: “Visually indicate that an Invoiced or Paid work order can only be reordered within its current technician, not moved to another one.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. AUTOMATION: READY

steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View"). Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Clear Shifts Scope" in Search. Drag [WO-1] from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column. Read the prompt that opens, then click Clear shifts. Drag [WO-2] from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column. In the prompt click Keep shifts. Open the Schedule for tomorrow and the day after, and read every shift on [WO-1], [WO-2] and [WO-3].
expected: Expected results Both drags open a prompt asking whether to clear Esther Howard's scheduled shifts for the whole work order. After Clear shifts: "S1-702" is led by Ralph Edwards, Esther Howard's 8:00–12:00 whole-work-order shift on it is gone, Dana Ortiz's 8:00–10:00 shift on it is still there, and Esther Howard's shift on "S1-691" is untouched. After Keep shifts: "S1-698" is led by Ralph Edwards and both Esther Howard shifts on it are still there. Esther Howard's 13:00–15:00 Line 1 shifts are still there on both work orders: the prompt never clears line shifts. What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): changing the lead (by dragging the card or with Reassign lead technician) shows no question about scheduled shifts, even when the outgoing lead has a shift booked for the entire work order. The lead changes at once with the "Lead technician updated" (or "Lead technician removed") message, and the outgoing lead's shift stays on the Schedule. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R11, S4-R22, S4-R23, S4-R24, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions DR-31 (optional whole-work-order shift clearing). Schedule shift picker labels "Entire work order" / "Choose lines" from the Schedule suite. Source-verified 8 October 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S4-R11: “When changing the lead technician in Board View or Tech View, ask whether to clear the outgoing lead’s work-order-level scheduled shifts.” S4-R22: “If the user chooses to clear shifts, remove only the outgoing lead’s shifts scheduled against that whole work order.” S4-R23: “If the user chooses to keep shifts, change the lead technician and retain the existing shifts.” S4-R24: “Never clear shifts scheduled against individual work order lines through this prompt.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] (e.g. Ralph Edwards), [Tech-C] (e.g. Dana Ortiz). Give [Tech-A] an email you can open, accept the invite and set a password, so [Tech-A] can sign in. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Status And Time Kept" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Status And Time Kept": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A]. As [Tech-A] (second browser) click Start time clock on the line's Labor row, wait at least 1 minute, click Stop time clock, then click Start time clock again and leave it running; the work order now reads In Progress. Write down the line's Actual hours (e.g. "0.02 / 2.00") and the work order's Total Hours. On the Schedule, give [Tech-A] a shift on the work order tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto [Tech-A]'s row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save. If your shop locks time entries (timesheet approval), lock one of [Tech-A]'s entries on this work order; otherwise write 'no locked time on this site' in the result comment. If not, redo the missing step before starting.
steps: On the Schedule, drag [Tech-A]'s shift on this work order to 13:00–17:00, then resize it to 13:00–16:00, then drag it onto [Tech-C]'s row. Open the work order and read Lead Technician and Status. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View"). Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Status And Time Kept" in Search. Drag the card from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column and click Clear shifts if the prompt opens. Open the work order and read Status, the running clock, the line's Actual hours and Total Hours.
expected: Expected results Moving, resizing and reassigning the shift on the Schedule does not change the lead: Lead Technician still reads Esther Howard after step 2. After the lead change the Status still reads In Progress. Recorded time is unchanged (Actual hours and Total Hours as written down, plus only the minutes the running clock added), Esther Howard's clock is still running, and any locked entry is unchanged. Review Decisions DR-18 / DR-31. Source-verified 8 October 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S4-R19: “Moving, resizing, or reassigning a shift on the Schedule does not change the work order’s lead technician. This is how the Schedule behaves today, and it stays that way.” S4-R20: “A lead change leaves work order status unchanged.” S4-R21: “Lead changes and optional shift clearing leave active, recorded, and locked time unchanged.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. title: The dialog's open count is the technician's Approved to Complete work

Setup Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Nina Newtech must be newly created for this case: if a staff member with that name already has work orders, the expected count will not match. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Open Count" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). How to reach each status (standard steps): Estimate = a new work order whose lines are not approved. Approved = approve its lines. In Progress = a technician clicks Start time clock on an approved line's Labor row. Review = set the work order to Ready for Review with its status control. Complete = enter a tech story on every line, complete each line, then complete the work order. Invoiced = Finance tab > Create Invoice (the work order needs a contact person). Paid = record a full payment on that invoice. Declined = decline the estimate. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Open Count" with Lead Technician [Tech-B] (set the lead while they are open; while a work order is an Estimate its lead is set from Board View: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign): 1 Estimate, 1 Approved, 1 In Progress, 1 Review, 1 Complete, 1 Invoiced, 1 Paid, 1 Declined. Create 1 more Approved work order for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Open Count" led by [Tech-A] where [Tech-B] is only the technician on a line (Edit Line > Technicians = [Tech-B]). Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Open Count" shows the eight work orders led by [Tech-B] in the eight statuses listed and the one led by [Tech-A]; [Tech-B] leads no other work order at this location. steps: Open Work Orders, click the Work Orders tab (so Estimates, Invoiced and Paid are filtered out of the page) and pick Board View. expected: Expected results Nina Newtech's count reads 4 open: Approved 1 + In Progress 1 + Review 1 + Complete 1 = 4. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R15, read 8 Oct 2026. The number is an example; what must hold: at least one work order with status Imported at this location. Setup Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). expected: Expected results Reassign lead technician is disabled on the Imported work order and its tooltip reads exactly: The lead technician can’t be changed on an imported work order. expected: Expected results Yesterday's 8:00–12:00 shift is unchanged. Tomorrow's 8:00–12:00 shift is gone. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S4-R25: “When the user chooses to clear shifts: a shift that has already ended stays as it is; a shift that has not started yet is removed; a shift that is under way at the moment of the lead change is ended at that moment, so the part already under way stays on the schedule and the rest is removed. steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View"). Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Where" in Search. Drag the card from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column. Note whether the prompt opens, click Keep shifts. Drag the card back into [Tech-A]'s column. Use More actions > Reassign lead technician to pick [Tech-B] and confirm. Note the prompt, click Keep shifts. Move it back to [Tech-A] the same way. Pick Tech View and repeat steps 3 to 6 with the row (drag between groups, then the row's More actions). Open the work order page and change Lead Technician from [Tech-A] to [Tech-B] there. expected: Expected results The prompt opens 4 times: Board View drag, Board View dialog, Tech View drag and Tech View dialog. Changing the lead on the work order page does not show the prompt, and the List offers no lead change at all, so no prompt appears there either (as today). Esther Howard's 8:00–12:00 shift is still on the Schedule (every choice was Keep shifts or no prompt). (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead. section: S4 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician
title: Searching in the Reassign lead technician dialog narrows the technician list
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes. Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher. One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location. Three eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] "Esther Howard", [Tech-B] "Ralph Edwards", [Tech-C] "Dana Ortiz". A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. No other eligible technician at this location has "ral" anywhere in its name (any case), and none matches "zzqx". One staff member who must NOT be offered: an Office-role user "Owen Office". Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A]. The staff names are used in the expected results (and typed in the steps) and stay as written; the number is an example. The expected results quote the design as "S1-702 · ZZ Board Test Co": on this run that is [WO-1] · ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search. Setup Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] = "Ralph Edwards" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-C] = "Dana Ortiz" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it). One staff member who must NOT be offered: an Office-role user ("Owen Office"). Create them the same way under Settings > Staff, but pick the Office role. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-702"): Lead Technician = [Tech-A]. Check the setup worked: Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" on Work Orders > All shows [WO-1] with Lead Technician [Tech-A]; Settings > Staff shows no other active technician at this location whose name contains "ral" (e.g. "Fitzgerald" does). If one does, switch off Time Clock on that staff record for this case (and turn it back on afterwards). Then clear the search.
steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View"). Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Dialog Search" in Search. Hover [WO-1]'s card in [Tech-A]'s column and click its More actions (…) button. Choose Reassign lead technician. Read the top of the dialog and the list of choices. Click the dialog's search box (it reads "Search technicians") and type Ral Clear the search box and type ral (all lower case). Clear the search box and type Owen Clear the search box and type zzqx Clear the search box. Click Cancel. Open the same card's More actions menu again and choose Reassign lead technician. Read the search box. Click Cancel. Pick Tech View in the display switcher and repeat steps 3 to 14 using the row's More actions (…) button.
expected: Expected results Step 5: the dialog names the work order it is changing, by number and customer (in the design: "S1-702 · ZZ Board Test Co"), and marks Esther Howard as the current lead (the design highlights her with a check mark). Write down what you see; a different layout alone is not a fail. Step 5: the list offers Unassigned and the eligible technicians of this location, e.g. Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz. Step 6: only technicians whose name contains "Ral" stay in the list: Ralph Edwards. Esther Howard and Dana Ortiz disappear from it. Step 7: lower-case "ral" gives the same list, Ralph Edwards only. Upper or lower case does not matter. Step 8: no technician is listed for "Owen". Owen Office has the Office role and is never offered, not even by searching. Steps 8 and 9: when nothing matches, the dialog says so and repeats what you typed (in the design: No technicians match “zzqx”). Write down the words you see; a different wording alone is not a fail. Step 10: clearing the search box brings back the whole list from step 5. Step 11: nothing changes. The card stays in Esther Howard's column and no message appears. Step 13: the search box is empty when the dialog opens again. Step 15: Tech View behaves the same way, and the row stays in Esther Howard's group. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R12, S4-R14 and section 8 "Design updates required from Branko" (Reassign dialog content and search), read 8 Oct 2026. Eligibility from PRD section 5 Terminology (Technician). Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Branko Cicovic, Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): Reassign dialog subtitle "work order number · customer" (assignSub, line 1363), search box "Search technicians" (line 357) keeping the technicians whose name contains the typed text in any letter case (lines 1180-1181), current lead highlighted with a check mark, no-match text "No technicians match “the typed text”" (line 1366), search emptied each time the dialog opens (openAssign, line 900). Design crawl 8 Oct 2026: Board View state 225 and Tech View state 193 ("S1-702 · Fibridge Commercial"), Board View states 227-228 ("No technicians match “Fib”", "No technicians match “zzqx-no-match”"). Design-only details (subtitle, search behaviour, no-match text, current-lead mark) are cited to the design; the PRD does not fix their wording. The list content (eligible technicians and Unassigned) follows S4-R12. Source-verified 8 October 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S4-R12: “The dialog offers eligible active technicians in the current location and Unassigned.” S4-R14: “Canceling the dialog leaves the lead unchanged.” Design updates required from Branko: “Reassign dialog content, search, grouping, avatars, and exact “N open” count.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. AUTOMATION: READY

section: S5 — Choose what is shown (fields and columns)
title: Tech View keeps its own column choice, separate from List, for each user
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 1 user · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List. [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location. A second location [Loc-2] you can switch to (your initials at the top right > Change Location), e.g. "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" (the case's earlier example was "Trailer Shop", which does not exist on this site); your user is enrolled at both. One technician at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Own Columns" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location. One Approved work order for that customer, [WO-1], led by [Tech-A], so List and Tech View have a row. A second browser or computer is available. Setup Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member, enter First Name and Last Name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email. Pick a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), pick at least one Department (required), set Location to this location and turn Time Clock on, then click Save & Close. Record as [Tech-A]. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Own Columns" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create the work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Own Columns" and its Asset > Save, and record its number as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-702"). The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page and choose [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Own Columns — [WO-1] shows, status Approved, led by [Tech-A]; your initials at the top right > Change Location lists [Loc-2]. If [Loc-2] is missing, add it to your own staff record (Settings > Staff > your own row's edit icon > Location).
steps: Open Work Orders in List, open Column Selection and write down which columns are on. Pick Tech View, open its Column Selection menu, turn Service Advisor off and Assigned Techs on. Pick List and read whether Service Advisor and Assigned Techs changed there. In List turn Progress off. Pick Tech View and read whether Progress changed there. Log out, log back in and open Tech View. In the second browser sign in as the same user and open Tech View. Switch to [Loc-2] (your initials at the top right > Change Location) and open Tech View. Open List in each of the above and read its columns.
expected: Expected results Tech View's choice does not touch List: after step 3 List still shows Service Advisor (and has no Assigned Techs). List's choice does not touch Tech View: after step 5 Tech View still shows Progress. Tech View keeps Service Advisor off and Assigned Techs on after logging back in, in the second browser and at the second location. List keeps its own columns (Progress off) exactly as it saves them today. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R1, S5-R8, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions DR-33 (Tech View's column selection separate from List both ways). Source-verified 8 October 2026. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S5-R1: “Tech View has its own optional-column selection, separate from List. Changing columns in Tech View never changes List, and changing columns in List never changes Tech View.” S5-R8: “Save the Tech View column selection per user across logout/login, devices, and locations. List keeps saving its columns exactly as it does today.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. AUTOMATION: READY

steps: Open Work Orders, pick Tech View and note where its Column Selection menu sits in the toolbar and how it works. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View"). Type ZZAUTOTEST F2 Board Fields Saved in Search. This part cannot be checked by hand; write 'usage recording not checked by hand' in the result comment (the Usage analytics folder covers it). Technicians "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards" at this location (the expected results name them, so keep these names), each able to sign in (an email you can open, invitation accepted, password set). steps: Open Work Orders in List, search for ZZAUTOTEST F2 Card Field Values and write down the [WO-1] row's values: Lead Technician, Customer, Asset, VIN/Serial #, Progress, Service Advisor, Clocked In, Lines, Assigned Tech, Total price, On Site, Created on. Hover the Clocked In value and read the names. Pick Board View, open Fields to display and count the optional fields offered. Turn every optional field on. Compare each field on the [WO-1] card with the List value, and hover the clocked-in field.
expected: Expected results Fields to display offers 13 optional fields: lead technician name, customer, asset (year/make/model), VIN/serial, progress, service advisor, clocked in, line count, line technicians, estimated hours, total price, on-site indicator and created date. section: S9 — Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns
title: Work orders can be dragged within a technician and to another technician
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 25 minutes Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher). Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher. Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location. Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Delta Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Echo Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Bravo Co", "Charlie Co", "Delta Co", "Echo Co"). Work orders (all Approved): lead Ana — Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co; lead Ben — Delta Co; lead Cal — Echo Co. Ana's group starts in the order Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co (with the example data). None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts". Setup Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Delta Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order Echo Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co"). Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order" in Search — exactly 5 work orders show, all Approved: Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co led by Ana; Delta Co led by Ben; Echo Co led by Cal. On the Schedule none of them has a shift. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
steps: Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Drag Order" in Search so only this case's work orders show. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View"). In Ana's group, write down the order of the three rows (with the example data: Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co). Press on the Charlie Co row and drag it above the Alpha Co row, then release. Drag the Bravo Co row from Ana's group into Ben's group, below the Delta Co row, and release. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View"). In Ben's column, drag the Bravo Co card above the Delta Co card and release. Drag the Echo Co card from Cal's column into Ana's column, below the last card, and release.
expected: Expected results After step 5, Ana's group lists Charlie Co, Alpha Co, Bravo Co: the row moved inside the group to where you dropped it. After step 6, Bravo Co is listed in Ben's group below Delta Co and is gone from Ana's group. After step 8, Ben's column shows Bravo Co above Delta Co. After step 9, Echo Co is the last card in Ana's column and Cal's column is empty. Every drag in both Tech View and Board View was allowed and the row or card stayed where you released it. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R1, read 8 Oct 2026. [User-A] also does the setup. [User-B]: a view-only user (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer") whose role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") has under Work orders only View ticked, at the test location; signed in later in a second browser or a private window. No technician is pinned for [User-B], and [User-B] has not reordered the technicians yet. Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location. Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field. Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Golf Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Golf Co"). Work orders (both Approved): lead Ana — Alpha Co; no lead — Golf Co. Starting technician order: Unassigned first, then technicians by first name (Ana, Ben, Cal) for both users. Setup Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close. Create a view-only user (skip if one exists): Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Skip > Role Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") > under Work orders tick only View > Create. Then Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer", an email inbox you can open) with that role at the test location, and finish the invite so the user can sign in. Record this user as [User-B]. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order Golf Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co"). Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Viewer Column Order" in Search — exactly 2 work orders show, both Approved: Alpha Co led by Ana, Golf Co with no lead. title: Field selection rate is one combined share across all users, not an average
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 4 users · 1 browser · Google Analytics access · steps on two days of one week, report read after the week · about 20 minutes of work Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher). Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location. Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page. Four test users at this location with Work Orders view (Settings > Staff): U1, U2 and U3 with see financial data, U4 without. Each has the default Board View fields (VIN/Serial off, Total price on). You can open the Story 12 field selection report in Google Analytics (built and kept by Milos Vasic). Do the steps on two different days of the same week (Monday to Sunday). Setup Settings > Staff: add four users at this location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Rate U1" … "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Rate U4") and finish each invite so they can sign in. U1, U2 and U3 get a role with Work Orders View and see financial data; U4 a role with Work Orders View but not see financial data (Settings > Roles & Permissions > create a custom role, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST No Money"). Record them as U1, U2, U3, U4. Check the setup worked: each of U1–U4 can sign in and open Work Orders; as U4, Board View's Fields to display does not offer Total price. If a user cannot sign in, finish the invite first.
steps: Day 1: sign in as U1, open Work Orders > Board View > the Fields to display menu, turn VIN/Serial on, then off, then on again. Day 2: sign in as U2 and turn VIN/Serial on in Board View. Day 2: sign in as U3, open Board View and turn Total price off. Day 2: sign in as U4 and open Board View (change nothing). After the week, open the field selection report for Board View for that week, filtered to these four users if the report allows.
expected: Expected results VIN/Serial: 4 users saw it (U1 to U4) and 2 have it on (U1, U2), so the rate is 2 ÷ 4 = 50%. U1 counts once however many times they toggled. The report must not show the average of daily rates. Day 1 = 1 ÷ 1 = 100% and day 2 = 1 ÷ 3 = 33.3%, so their average of 66.7% would be wrong. The correct figure is 50%. Total price: only U1, U2 and U3 could see it (U4 has no financial data). U1 and U2 have it on (default) and U3 turned it off, so the rate is 2 ÷ 3 = 66.7%, not 2 ÷ 4 = 50%. Rounding: write down how the report rounds (e.g. 66.7% or 67%). The number must round from 2 ÷ 3. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R10, S12-R7, S12-R13, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) section 3.21 and Phase 10. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S12-R10: “Report field selection rate by field and display: distinct exposed users selecting the field divided by distinct users exposed to that available field.” S12-R7: “Exclude unavailable financial fields from field-exposure measurement and its denominator.” S12-R13: “Do not count repeated events from one user as additional users.” Tech plan Phase 10 sample calculation: “Each needs a named owner (product analytics, not engineering) and a sample calculation checked against a seeded week (S12-E2).” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. title: Money fields are left out of field usage for users without financial data
preconds: Preconditions Needs: 2 users · 1 browser · Google Analytics DebugView access · about 15 minutes Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher). Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher. Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location. Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page. Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change). [User-B]: a user without the see financial data permission, whose role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST No Money") has Work Orders View and Create & Edit but not see financial data. [User-B] has never changed Fields to display, so all fields load at their defaults. Setup Settings > Roles & Permissions > create a custom role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST No Money") with Work Orders View and Create & Edit but not see financial data. Add a staff member with that role and sign them in; record them as [User-B]. Start a fresh analytics session: close every browser window, open a new private window and sign in as [User-B]. Check the setup worked: Google Analytics > Admin > DebugView opens and shows your device within a few seconds of opening any ShopView page. If it does not, carry on but write "not checked by hand" for the event checks, as the Preconditions say.
steps: As [User-B], the user without see financial data, open Work Orders and click Board View. In DebugView, count the work_orders_field_load events and look for total_price. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View"). Count the new work_orders_field_load events and look for total_price. Open Fields to display in Board View and look for Total price.
expected: Expected results Step 2: 12 field events (13 − 1). No event for total price. Step 4: 14 field events (15 − 1). No event for total price. Step 5: Total price is not offered in the picker, and no card shows a dollar amount. Total for this user: 12 + 14 = 26. Total price is left out of usage completely for this user, so it cannot lower that field's usage rate. Source — where this behaviour comes from Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display and columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R7, S5-E2, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility) S12-R7: “Exclude unavailable financial fields from field-exposure measurement and its denominator.” S5-E2: “Without see financial data permission, hide all dollar-amount fields from displays, filters, and field/column pickers.” Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026. AUTOMATION: HOLD - not manually testable (developer/automated check only)
